why: Quote verified verbatim at sub-agents.md:617 (whole line, nothing reverses it), and the identifier half of the claim is true: `hooks` is absent from `UserAgentDefinition` (packages/shared/src/agents/definitions.ts:253-271) and from `AgentDefinition` (:58-122). The CONSEQUENCE is false, which is the refutation. (1) NOT SILENT. `reportFrontmatterHookDeclarations` (packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:437-500, invoked for every adapter at :375-382) reads each imported skill/agent file, and on presence of a `hooks` frontmatter key pushes a `warning` diagnostic `plugin.format.frontmatter_hooks_unregistered` ('Subagent "<path>" declares frontmatter hooks. Nessy does not register component-scoped hooks, so they will not run...') PLUS a deferral `{externalKind:'hook', reasonCode:'plugin.deferred.frontmatter_hooks_unregistered', sourcePath}` that forces `compatibility.state` to `partial`. That is the SAME `compatibility.deferred` channel the claim says this is 'unlike' (TeammateIdle) — so the stated contrast is exactly backwards. The covering test (packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/format-adapters.test.ts:88-142) builds a Claude bundle whose `agents/reviewer.md` carries precisely a `hooks: Stop:` block and asserts the warning + deferral + `partial`; run at HEAD: 4 pass / 0 fail. (2) RECORDED OWNER DECISION, twice. Parity-audit row D9 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-25-nessy-claude-parity-audit.md:737) is this exact finding, closed 2026-07-30 by commit e1d322a1 ('fix(plugins): skill and subagent frontmatter hooks register or are refused') deliberately as the LOUD-REFUSAL half: 'Registration was not attempted: it needs the component-lifetime scoping the page describes, and the adapter half was locked.' Row R30c (:698) separately costed `hooks` and deliberately did not half-build it — 'no per-subagent hook scope and the value is a nested event map the flat parser cannot represent'. (3) FOR THE CASE THE CLAIM NAMES, THE DROP IS DOC-CONFORMANT. The claim's subject is 'an imported Claude agent file', i.e. a plugin bundle; sub-agents.md:229 says plugin subagents do not support `hooks`/`mcpServers`/`permissionMode` and 'These fields are ignored when loading agents from a plugin.' Nessy enforces that structurally, deleting the three keys before any read (packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/runtime-agent-definition.ts:388-431, PLUGIN_IGNORED_AGENT_FRONTMATTER), and that code comment quotes the same doc line — so for plugin agents our behaviour MATCHES Claude, it does not diverge. (4) Wrong-subsystem citation. The claimed proof that SubagentStart/SubagentStop are supported, `plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:171-172`, points at the dead second hook executor that inert-worklist section 3 item 5 lists as an owner decision ('Do not revive hooks-runtime.ts... a second, unreachable hook executor'); the live contract is AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1 in packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:66-67. The conclusion is right, the evidence names the wrong subsystem.
correctedState: Per-agent frontmatter `hooks` are genuinely not REGISTERED in Nessy — there is no component-lifetime hook scope, and no `Stop`->`SubagentStop` conversion — but they are not silently dropped, and the gap is a dated recorded decision, not an unnoticed defect. Since commit e1d322a1 (2026-07-30, parity row D9) any imported skill or subagent whose frontmatter carries a `hooks:` key produces a warning diagnostic (`plugin.format.frontmatter_hooks_unregistered`) and a deferral (`plugin.deferred.frontmatter_hooks_unregistered`) in the same channel as the TeammateIdle deferral, downgrading the bundle to `partial` and failing `validate --strict`. For plugin-bundled subagents specifically — the case the finding cites — not honouring `hooks` is what sub-agents.md:229 requires, and Nessy enforces it structurally by deleting the key before any field is read (runtime-agent-definition.ts:399-431). Session-wide `SubagentStart`/`SubagentStop` are live via automations/types.ts:66-67, not via the dead plugins/hooks-runtime.ts. The only open residue is registration of frontmatter-scoped hooks for NATIVE (non-plugin) agent definitions, costed and deferred under R30c.
